title: Default Assessment Tool Integration
description: MVP installer for a generic assessment vendor integration. Creates assessment type storage, an application-level assessment form, import services for creation/results, and a Junction integration with sync, create, and result-update flows.

content.text:
The next step will create the **integration user**: `assessment.integration`.

- **Purpose:** executor account for the default assessment integration.
- **Depends on:** the role selected below.

Click **Next** to continue.

input.name: Assessment Vendor API Credential
input.description: Credential shell for the assessment vendor API.

content.text:
The next step will create the **credential shell**: `Assessment Vendor API Credential`.

- **Type:** Basic Auth by default. Change this only if the vendor requires another authentication method.
- **Scope:** Company Wide Password Manager.
- **Available in:** Junction.

Enter the final vendor credentials in Password Manager after the shell exists.

Click **Next** to continue.

The next step will create the **default assessment datasets**.

- **Dataset:** `Assessment Types` stores vendor-provided assessment catalogs.
- **Dataset:** `Assessment Status` stores lifecycle statuses used by the application form.
- **Reusable dataset:** select an existing Active/Inactive dataset for the `Is Active?` field in Assessment Types.

Click **Next** to continue.

value.2: Assessment requested but not yet created

content.text:
The next steps will add the default **Assessment Status** values: `Pending`, `Created`, `Completed`, and `Error`.

Click **Next** to continue.

value.2: Assessment creation or result update failed

content.text:
The next step will create the default **Assessment** form on the Job-Candidate relationship/application.

- **Assessment ID:** vendor identifier used for deduplication.
- **Status:** controlled status dataset.
- **Status Additional Info:** error or lifecycle details.
- **Assessment URL:** candidate-facing assessment link.
- **Results Report URL:** recruiter-facing report link.

Click **Next** to continue.

content.text:
The next step will create the default **Import Services**.

- **Assessment Creation:** writes the vendor assessment ID, status, details, and assessment URL to the application form.
- **Assessment Results:** updates the same form with completion status, details, and the result report URL.
- **Deduplication:** Candidate by Avature ID; Assessment form by `Assessment ID` related to the job.

Click **Next** to continue.

content.text:
The next step will install the **Junction integration**: `assessmentVendor`.

- **Flows:** `syncAssessmentTypes`, `createAssessment`, and `updateAssessmentResults`.
- **Triggers:** workflow step action for creation; HTTP endpoint for result updates.
- **Services:** the two Import Services, Integration Logs, the assessment-result endpoint slot, and execution history.

Click **Next** to continue.

content.text:
Everything that can be installed by this MVP instructor has been set up.

**These parts still require confirmation:**

- **Vendor credentials and endpoint:** enter final credentials in Password Manager and configure the endpoint/credential parameters.
- **Assessment type sync:** confirm the vendor payload and map it to the `Assessment Types` dataset fields.
- **Workflow step:** attach the `Create Assessment` trigger to the customer workflow step.
- **Candidate email:** choose the correct candidate email source.
- **Candidate phone:** choose the correct candidate phone source and decide whether it is required.
- **Job assessment type:** confirm whether the job assessment type is needed and whether it should be sourced from the `Assessment Types` dataset.
- **HTTP endpoint:** confirm the generated `updateAssessmentResults` endpoint URL and provide it to the vendor.
- **Import services:** confirm API key/url service bindings and test deduplication by `Assessment ID` on the application form.
- **URLs:** validate whether URL fields should remain text fields or use a stricter URL field/validator where available.

Click **Next** to finish.
